name: Megaminx Madness AZ 2026

venue.name: The University of Arizona Student Union Memorial Center
venue.details: Tucson Room - Located on the 3rd floor of the University of Arizona Student Union Memorial Center

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MegaminxMadnessAZ2026#70922-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
